description: Cofounder dispatches a CPA-regression investigation scoped to Brand Search; google-ads-agent claims, reads API creds from the vault, pulls change-history + auction-insights via the API, confirms the diagnosis in the UI via browser, ships the reversible fix (reverts a broadened match-type change), and completes with result + digest.

dispatch.title: Investigate CPA regression on Brand Search

args.title: Investigate CPA regression on Brand Search

args.note: GAQL: change_event + auction insights for Brand Search, last 14d
confirm match-type broadening landed in UI on 2026-06-08
revert 6 keywords from broad back to phrase match

args.result: Root cause: CPA on Brand Search rose from $39 to $58 after 6 keywords were broadened to broad match on 2026-06-08, pulling in non-brand queries. Reversible fix shipped: reverted the 6 keywords to phrase match. No spend-increasing remedy needed; expect CPA to recover within 3 days.
args.digest: Diagnosed google.root_cause on Brand Search CPA: broad-match drift from 06-08, reverted 6 keywords to phrase. Next wake: check CPA trend on Brand Search before tomorrow's sweep.
